'''Sixtus Cleft''' was a [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] onboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. He was, at one [[Time/Legends|time]], the leader of the [[Delphanian Face Gang]], before he [[Death/Legends|died]] in an "unfortunate accident" arranged by fellow gang member [[Aur Myss]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Von Longo]] trusted him, and arranged deals with him.
